footer.copyright: Ernso Azor. Revealing what was always there.

personalIntro.p1: I’m Ernso Azor, a brand designer and strategist based in Curitiba, Brazil, with 8+ years spent working across institutions, professionals, and creatives who refuse to be average. I help people and companies uncover what actually makes them different, then build an identity that puts it on full display. Not decoration. Not guesswork. I look for the truth that’s already sitting inside a brand, the part its owner usually can’t see because they’re too close to it, and I give it a shape the world can’t ignore.
personalIntro.p2: I’m on a mission to work with ambitious institutions, driven professionals, and bold creatives ready to be seen at the level they actually operate, not the one their current presence suggests.
personalIntro.p3: Whether you’re a corporation ready to lead with the authority you’ve already earned, or an artist ready to be felt before you’re heard, I bring the same discipline: strategy first, storytelling that makes people look twice, and craft that makes sure they remember you.

worlds.title: The worlds I operate in.
worlds.world1Body: For institutions that operate at scale and need a brand presence as strong as the work they do. Strategic identity systems that command credibility in boardrooms, with partners, and in public, before a single word is spoken.
worlds.world2Body: For driven professionals who have built real expertise and now need the world to see it clearly. A personal brand that positions them at the level they actually operate, not the one their current presence suggests.
worlds.world3Body: For artists, influencers, and public figures who move audiences but haven't yet built the brand architecture to match their talent. Full brand identity, social positioning, and a system that makes their presence as powerful as their work.

testimonials.title: What they say.
testimonials.t1quote: Ernso didn't just design our identity, he uncovered it. Boardrooms take us seriously now in a way they didn't before.
testimonials.t2quote: My personal brand finally matches the level I actually operate at. Clients now come to me already convinced.
testimonials.t3quote: He made my presence feel as powerful as my music. The whole system, visuals, tone, story, finally lines up.
testimonials.t4quote: He translated a decade of institutional work into a presence that finally commands the room. Partners notice immediately.
testimonials.t5quote: Every touchpoint now feels deliberate. Clients tell me they trusted us before we even opened our mouths.
